script.title: The Twice-Seen Scarab
script.script:
Ivo Rusk crouches in the Sand Chamber beside the Low Arch. He rakes the Sand Bank apart and hauls the Sun Scarab completely out, revealing it. He thrusts the Sun Scarab into the Chest Satchel and snaps it shut. The disturbed Sand Bank slumps forward, burying Ivo Rusk to the waist. He twists, digs furiously, then seizes the Low Arch and heaves. Still pinned, Ivo Rusk rises slightly, clearly visible and straining mid-pull.

Without a break, Ivo Rusk heaves again and claws himself completely free of the Sand Bank. He ducks through the Low Arch into the adjoining Escape Gallery, the Chest Satchel still closed against him. Only after clearing the Low Arch does he wrench the Chest Satchel open. He pulls the Sun Scarab entirely out and raises it toward the camera, revealing it again. Ivo Rusk keeps moving deeper into the Escape Gallery with the Sun Scarab plainly visible.

elements.name: Ivo Rusk
elements.spec: Ivo Rusk is an original fictional male adventurer of about thirty-five and must not resemble any real actor or recognizable person. He has warm copper skin, a broad left cheekbone and noticeably narrower right cheekbone, a short hooked nose, a cleft square chin, one amber eye and one gray eye, and close-cropped black hair with a narrow white forelock; his build is tall, wiry, and long-armed. He wears a mustard-yellow cotton shirt with sleeves rolled above the elbows, a rust-red neckerchief, high-waisted charcoal trousers, a dark-brown leather belt, and scuffed dark-brown lace-up boots, with no hat, coat, or gloves. The Chest Satchel is strapped high against his right ribs, and he begins crouching beside the Sand Bank.

elements.name: Chest Satchel
elements.spec: A flat rectangular russet-brown leather satchel, two hands wide and one hand tall, hangs high against Ivo Rusk's right ribs from a narrow dark-brown diagonal shoulder strap. Its single broad flap has one black iron snap and begins folded open, exposing a plain dark interior.

elements.name: Sun Scarab
elements.spec: A palm-length oval scarab carved from solid dull-gold brass, thick enough to grasp securely in one hand, has deeply incised symmetrical wing markings and one triangular notch along its lower edge. It begins completely buried inside the Sand Bank, with no portion exposed.

elements.name: Sand Bank
elements.spec: A steep wedge of coarse ochre sand stands roughly six handspans high, twelve handspans across, and eight handspans deep against the Sand Chamber's rear wall beside the Low Arch. Its intact sloping front reaches Ivo Rusk's crouching position, and its surface is smooth except for shallow finger marks directly before him.

elements.name: Sand Chamber
elements.spec: A narrow rectangular chamber has tall, rough pale-sandstone walls and a level sandstone floor, with the Sand Bank occupying its rear-right corner. An open roof supplies natural daylight, and there is no furniture or artificial lighting. The Low Arch occupies the right wall immediately beside the Sand Bank; from the starting camera angle, its thick side conceals the adjoining Escape Gallery.

elements.name: Low Arch
elements.spec: A doorless opening connects the Sand Chamber and Escape Gallery through a thick sandstone wall, with rough ochre sides and a shallow curved top. It is slightly wider than Ivo Rusk's shoulders and reaches only his chest when he stands, requiring him to duck. Its bare stone floor is flush with both adjoining floors, it contains no furniture or fixtures, and daylight reaches it from the adjoining spaces.

elements.name: Escape Gallery
elements.spec: A straight, narrow gallery has blue-gray basalt walls and a flat blue-gray stone floor, visibly different from the Sand Chamber's pale sandstone. A long open roof slot supplies natural daylight, and there is no furniture or artificial lighting. The Low Arch opens into one end, while the empty gallery extends several paces beyond it.
